title: Amorous Mustard Uruguayan Lamb Terrine
description: A mustardy, velvety terrine that brings romance to the Uruguayan table, perfect for a special dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C and set a terracotta dish on a rack inside a larger pan filled with water up to halfway for a bain-marie.
Season lamb slices with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear lamb slices until browned, about 2 minutes per side, then transfer to the terracotta dish.
In the same skillet, sauté shallot and garlic until translucent, then pour in red wine and reduce by half.
Stir in both mustards, rosemary, thyme, and lamb stock, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour the sauce evenly over the lamb in the terracotta dish, ensuring each piece is covered.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake in the bain-marie for 45 minutes until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove from oven, let rest 10 minutes, then serve warm with a drizzle of the remaining sauce.
